models_evaluated: Primary pretrained LVEF estimation model (Kaiser Permanente Northern California)

links.outcome: Model performance (MAE, R², AUC) on phone videos before and after fine-tuning on local phone-video data
links.effect: Primary model fine-tuning: MAE 7.00 to 6.96 pp, R² 0.49 to 0.61, AUC 0.91 to 0.93. EchoNet-Dynamic: MAE 9.36 to 7.86 pp, R² 0.37 to 0.50, AUC 0.84 to 0.89.
links.quote: Fine-tuning the public EchoNet-Dynamic model improved performance from 9.36 percentage points, 0.37, and 0.84 to 7.86 percentage points, 0.50, and 0.89, respectively.

links.outcome: Model performance under input variation (phone recording, progressive central zoom preprocessing)
links.effect: Phone-video input reduced performance versus native DICOM (MAE 7.00 vs 6.08 pp; R² 0.49 vs 0.60; AUC 0.91 vs 0.93), and progressive central zoom degraded performance.
links.quote: Progressive central zoom preprocessing degraded model performance.

links.outcome: Performance on phone-recorded versus native DICOM videos
links.effect: Phone videos worsened performance versus native DICOM: MAE 7.00 vs 6.08, R² 0.49 vs 0.60, AUC 0.91 vs 0.93.
links.quote: Without phone-video fine-tuning, the primary model achieved a mean absolute error of 7.00 percentage points, coefficient of determination of 0.49, and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.91 on phone-recorded videos; corresponding native DICOM performance was 6.08 percentage points, 0.60, and 0.93, respectively.

links.effect: EchoNet-Dynamic fine-tuning improved MAE/R²/AUC from 9.36/0.37/0.84 to 7.86/0.50/0.89.
links.quote: Fine-tuning the public EchoNet-Dynamic model improved performance from 9.36 percentage points, 0.37, and 0.84 to 7.86 percentage points, 0.50, and 0.89, respectively.

links.outcome: LVEF estimation accuracy on phone-recorded videos versus native DICOM
links.effect: MAE worsened from 6.08 to 7.00 percentage points, R² decreased from 0.60 to 0.49, and AUC decreased from 0.93 to 0.91
links.quote: Without phone-video fine-tuning, the primary model achieved a mean absolute error of 7.00 percentage points, coefficient of determination of 0.49, and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.91 on phone-recorded videos; corresponding native DICOM performance was 6.08 percentage points, 0.60, and 0.93, respectively.
